The Labor Relations, Sr Director is responsible for shaping and leading the company’s labor relations agenda while supporting the “You Matter” culture. This role partners with senior leadership to design strategies that foster positive labor-management relations, mitigate risk, and align with long-term business objectives. Key responsibilities include leading complex collective bargaining negotiations, managing arbitration and grievance processes, and overseeing company responses to regulatory matters. The position requires a proactive, collaborative leader with deep labor relations expertise, strong executive influence, and a demonstrated ability to promote a workplace culture where associates feel valued, respected, and supported.

This position has been segmented as Remote Anywhere meaning the work is completed 100% remote anywhere in the U.S. except Hawaii or United States Territories.

Responsibilities:

  • Direct labor relations activities, programs, and strategy implementation to achieve goals aligned with company objectives while fostering a “You Matter” culture where every associate feels valued and respected.

  • Serve as chief spokesperson in contract negotiations, representing the company and operationalizing labor policies that are both market-competitive and strategically aligned, while reinforcing a culture of inclusion and respect.

  • Provide advice and counsel in grievance-arbitration matters and occasionally act as company advocate in labor arbitration cases, ensuring consistent, fair, and equitable application of company policies and practices.

  • Manage the preparation and presentation of responses to charges under the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) with integrity and transparency.

  • Stay current on labor relations trends, case law, and best practices in the distribution industry, integrating relevant insights that support both business objectives and associate engagement.

  • Drive excellence in negotiations by ensuring thorough preparation and successful execution of labor contracts that balance organizational needs with associate value and respect.

  • Assess and develop labor and employee relations training programs, in partnership with business leaders, to build organizational capability and reinforce a “You Matter” culture.

  • Other duties as assigned by manager.

Relatoinships:

  • Internal: This role partners closely with Executive Leadership; Supply Chain and Field Operational leadership; Human Resources; Legal; and Finance
  • External: This role collaborates with union representatives, the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB), external labor counsel, industry associations, and consultants to manage labor negotiations, resolve disputes, ensure regulatory compliance, and incorporate best practices into the company’s labor relations strategy.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 7 years of labor relations experience, with relevant industry experience in retail, wholesale, manufacturing, consumer products, or distribution.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience presenting cases before the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB).

  • Extensive experience in the development and execution of labor relations strategies.

  • Hands-on experience negotiating collective bargaining agreements and labor contracts.

  • Proven ability to work with and influence leaders at all levels, from frontline supervisors to C-Suite executives.

  • Willingness to travel up to 75% of the time (with an average of approximately 50% travel).

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related discipline required. Law degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in leading labor relations within large, multi-site organizations.

  • Advanced knowledge of labor law and grievance-arbitration processes.

  • Track record of fostering a positive labor-management relationship and promoting a “You Matter” culture.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret labor trends and data to drive strategic decisions.

  • Proven ability to develop and mentor labor relations teams or HR professionals.

  • Experience managing high-profile or complex labor disputes with measurable outcomes.

This role will also receive an annual incentive plan bonus and a Long Term Incentive Plan (LTIP).

​Benefits for this role may include health insurance, pre-tax spending accounts, retirement benefits, paid time off, short-term and long-term disability, employee stock purchase plan, and life insurance. To review available benefits, please click here:

Compensation depends on relevant experience and/or education, specific skills, function, geographic location, and other factors as applicable by law (for example: state or local minimum wage thresholds). The expected base rate for this role is between

$145,000 - $225,000

Location: Remote (Company is based in Gilbert, AZ)

Salary Range: $65,000 - $85,000

Skyhook Interactive is one of Arizona's leading boutique website development firms and was named one of the Top 50 "Best Places To Work" by the Phoenix Business Journal. We're looking for a full-time, work-from-home WordPress Client Success Manager to join our growing team.

What makes this job great

Team. You will LOVE your co-workers! Skyhook works hard to recruit & retain team members who are humble, hungry and smart, and to maintain an environment that is positive and fun. This team will bring out the best in you.

Variety. You'll be involved in working on dozens of websites each year, giving you remarkable exposure to lots of different businesses and the people who run them.

Growth. You will be trained, mentored, and coached, then given opportunities to learn "on the job" by doing work for our amazing customers. Current and past clients include Olympic athletes, A-list influencers, top-tier eCommerce brands, and a long list of local heroes.

Flexibility. You'll be able to work from home and keep your own schedule for the most part, while still enjoying structure and regular in-person meetups with the team.

Impact. As a member of a small team, you'll have an outsized opportunity to have your voice heard and to impact the trajectory of the company.

Purpose. You will have a measurable impact on the organizations and lives of our customers. You will help us make the Internet a better place every single day.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Deliver outstanding customer service experiences by managing and triaging client requests from start to finish

  • Performing simple WordPress maintenance tasks yourself (updates/changes, plugins, and basic hosting tasks) and coordinating with our development team for more complex tasks projects

  • Conducting discovery calls and meetings with clients to identify underlying needs and pain points, scoping opportunities as appropriate

  • Serving as primary liaison between clients and internal development team, translating technical concepts into client-friendly language and vice versa

  • Identifying opportunities for additional services that could help clients reach their goals

  • Building client trust through consistent, quality delivery

  • Act as Project Manager on larger/more complex engagements, coordinating logistics, managing timelines, containing scope, and ensuring successful delivery

  • Conducting assessments for PageSpeed, ADA Compliance, and Security improvements

  • Collaborating on account expansion opportunities and client retention strategies

  • Helping to improve account services team and company-wide processes

Required Skills and Experience

Technical Foundation

  • Solid WordPress experience managing WordPress sites in a professional capacity

  • Understanding of WordPress best practices for security, performance, maintenance, and content management

  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for simple modifications and troubleshooting

  • Understanding of web fundamentals including hosting, domains, SSL certificates, and basic security concepts

  • Ability to perform WordPress updates, plugin management, and basic maintenance tasks independently

  • Familiarity with common WordPress plugins, themes, and the broader WordPress ecosystem

  • Good judgment about when to handle tasks yourself vs. when to get help from developers

  • Can troubleshoot common WordPress problems

Client Success & Business Skills

  • Excellent communication skills - Both written and verbal, with ability to explain technical concepts clearly to clients and coordinate effectively with development team

  • Business acumen - A natural ability to identify client opportunities, pain points, and growth potential

  • Account management mindset - Always looking for ways to add value and strengthen client relationships

  • Client-focused mindset - understanding that excellent project management and execution drives client satisfaction

  • Project coordination abilities - comfortable managing multiple client requests and determining appropriate resource allocation

  • Experience managing multiple client relationships simultaneously while maintaining high service standards

  • Proven track record in client services, customer success, or account management roles

Personal Qualities

  • High attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work within deadlines and budgets

  • Positive energy, enthusiasm, and professional demeanor

  • Work well in a collaborative team environment

  • Ability to perform under pressure while maintaining quality standards

  • Open to feedback, highly self-aware, and accountable

  • A good fit with our culture, and lives by our core values:

    • Think: Smart with an almost academic interest in learning & growing

    • Move: A bias for action and results-oriented approach

    • Own: Open to feedback, self-aware, and takes ownership of outcomes

    • Engage: Not afraid to get your hands dirty; eager to contribute

Tools & Collaboration

  • Familiarity with business operations suites and collaboration tools (Gmail, Slack, Asana)

  • Experience with ticketing systems and project management tools

Nice To Haves

  • Experience with hosting platforms (WP Engine), server administration (cPanel, Plesk), DNS management, SSL implementation, and website migrations

  • Advanced HTML, CSS (SASS or LESS), PHP, and JavaScript skills

  • Knowledge of accessibility and SEO best practices

  • Advanced Custom Fields, Gravity Forms, and Manage WP experience

  • Previous freelance experience with customer-facing WordPress projects

  • Translating technical expertise into business value and strategic recommendations

  • Background in client-facing technical roles or consulting environments

  • Overseeing multi-phase WordPress projects and coordinating resources over extended periods

Compensation & Benefits

Making sure you're well compensated for the support you give us is one of our top priorities. Typical benefits packages include:

  • Competitive salary of $65,000 - $85,000

  • A share in the profits when the company does well

  • Employer-paid health, disability and life insurance plans, with access to vision and dental insurance as well

  • 401k/Retirement plan options with 4% company match

  • Generous Flex and PTO policies, including the week between Christmas and New Year's

  • Career mentoring & coaching from seasoned professionals

  • Top-of-the-line company-issued hardware

  • Team builders, funtivities, volunteer opportunities, and other community-building initiatives

How To Land The Job

  1. Fill out our application form and tell us about yourself. Bonus points for including a video intro.

  2. Impress us during a couple of rounds of interviewing to assess your skills and cultural fit

  3. Write your grandma a letter (optional, but kind) and wait for the congratulatory phone call.

About Skyhook

Skyhook is a growing, fast-paced website development agency that provides high-end site strategy and technical implementation for organizations across the country. Current and past clients include national brands like AT&T, NFL, American Express, LifeLock and Subway, as well as local stars like Arizona State University, Banner Health, City of Phoenix, Pink Jeep Tours, and more.

Our team consists of a dozen talented marketing professionals—including designers, developers and project managers—who are passionate about using the Internet to help businesses grow and are eager to enhance their expertise through constant learning. We are mission-driven to make the Internet (and the world) a better place by pushing the limits of website performance. We're working hard to build sites that are more creative, higher converting, better ranking, easier to maintain, and more fun to build.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Role Title: Management Consultant

Role Type: Contractor.

Location: Remote, US-based.

micro1 is engaging Management Consultants to participate in a dynamic project supporting a leading client. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Design consulting-style tasks that mirror authentic workflows such as case team analyses, client communications, and board-level readouts.
  2. Create exemplary deliverables, including client-facing decks, executive summaries, detailed strategy memos, and structured recommendation documents.
  3. Develop and refine gold-standard example outputs, ensuring clarity, cohesive structure, and executive-readiness on par with senior consulting expectations.
  4. Assess and critique model-generated content for adherence to frameworks like MECE, clarity of reasoning, and actionable insights.
  5. Construct clear, actionable rubrics that differentiate between preliminary drafts and polished, boardroom-ready work.
  6. Identify and document common pitfalls in consulting communication, such as loss of structural integrity, unclear key messages, or verbose language.
  7. Collaborate with project stakeholders to align deliverables with evolving client and project requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum of 3 years' experience at a top-tier consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG, or similar).
  2. Proven track record producing client-ready decks, succinct executive documents, and strategic recommendations.
  3. Expertise applying structured problem-solving methodologies (e.g., MECE, pyramid principle, issue trees).
  4. Exceptional written English skills, with mastery of the executive communication register.
  5. Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to excellence in all deliverables.
  6. Master's degree preferred; MBA especially valued.
  7. Experience in evaluating and providing actionable feedback on consultancy outputs is a plus.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives and maintain consistent messaging across all platforms.

  • At least 3-5 years experience in B2B client acquisition

Summary:

The Customer Care Representative is primarily responsible for answering in-bound calls from customers wishing to place orders, inquire about an order, or resolve an issue for a single line of business at Sarnova. This position requires an individual who demonstrates care and empathy, a focus on results, and strong communication skills in working across many departments on behalf of the customer.

Organizational Impact:

In this role for Sarnova, you are our brand ambassador delivering delight in every interaction. You help deliver the right product, in the right hands, and in the right amount of time. You impact your line of business through empathy, order quality, first call resolution and promoting satisfied customers leading to growth, retention and advocacy.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Order Processing: Handle inbound calls and process orders through multiple channels, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in each transaction
  • Order Confirmation: Send order confirmations via email and provide customers with status updates and follow-ups to keep them informed throughout the order process
  • Order Accuracy: Review all orders for accuracy, make necessary adjustments to existing orders, and ensure orders are processed to fulfillment without delay
  • Special Orders Handling: Route special orders using the appropriate process and provide pricing information upon request
  • Customer Collaboration: Work closely with internal departments to address customer inquiries and act as a liaison to ensure customer needs are met
  • Product and Service Explanation: Learn and understand new products across a single product line to explain basic products and services to customers to aid in their purchasing decisions
  • Issue Resolution: Research and resolve billing and pricing inquiries, addressing customer concerns to ensure satisfaction and smooth order processing
  • Problem Solving: Resolve any order issues that prevent same-day shipping, and determine or authorize credits, rebills, and product returns when necessary
  • Administrative Support: Perform filing and other administrative tasks as needed

Skills/Experience Required:

  • Education: High School Diploma or equivalent
  • One to two years of customer service experience; experience should include an environment where calls were monitored and scored as well as metrics applied to individual and team performance
  • Strong computer skills; basic understanding of MS Outlook, Word and Excel
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; must be able to develop and maintain cooperative working relationships with customers and co-workers
  • Ability to deal calmly and effectively with situations via telephone while maintaining and promoting a positive company image
  • Able to diffuse an upset customer and/or an intense situation
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Experience working within a distribution company preferred
  • Emergency Medical or Hospital related experience a plus.
  • Ability to independently manage all aspects of the job role including required goals and business practices in a remote environment
  • Additional job duties as assigned

Physical Requirements:

  • Sit, walk, stand, use hands to manipulate, handle, feel, and control items or equipment
  • Reach with hands and arms
  • Talk and hear
  • See and be able to read, write, and interpret text
  • Employee may use computer, phone, copier and other office equipment in the course of a day
  • Occasionally lift and move objects weighing up to 10 pounds
  • Employee may be required to travel for business purposes
  • When working remotely, ability to secure confidential information
  • When working remotely, perform all duties in a professional environment free of noise or anything that would create a negative customer experience

Work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential function of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Continuous is defined as 6-8 hours, frequently is defined as 3-6 hours, and occasionally is defined as up to 3 hours. Work Schedule: Employee will be required to work a minimum of forty (40) hours of per week or as many hours as it may take to perform above job duties. Schedule may vary based on business demands and will require a combination of office hours as well as work performed after hours and/or weekends at times.

Sarnova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer a competitive salary, commensurate with experience, along with a comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k) Plan. EEO/M/F/Veterans/Disabled. Excellence in delivering upon our mission is dependent upon having a diverse team that is empowered to bring their full, authentic self to work each day. Job Title: Engagement Associate

Location: Remote

Company: PharmaForceIQ Inc.

Job Type: Full-time, Exempt

About Us:

We are a team of marketing strategists, digital innovators, life science leaders, and other professionals who are driving growth, pushing the envelope, and going above and beyond on behalf of our clients every day.

PharmaForceIQ is a real-time customer engagement platform built specifically for life sciences. We empower leaders across functions and brands with a faster, more effective way to engage healthcare professionals and patients. By streamlining real-time optichannel execution, leveraging AI, and focusing on measurable impact, we are driving a paradigm shift from sluggish, siloed customer engagement efforts to agile, data-driven strategies that deliver unmatched efficiency and tangible results.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an innovative Optichannel Associate with 0-2 years of experience in marketing, preferably within pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare agency environments. This role will own day-to-day optichannel program execution, lead cross-functional coordination, and ensure high-quality client deliverables across HCP, patient, and clinical trial recruitment campaigns. The Optichannel Associate will report to the Optichannel Engagement Manager and will serve as a key partner to both internal teams and external clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as primary day-to-day project lead for assigned accounts, managing timelines, deliverables, and communication across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Maintain and deepen client relationships by driving agendas for client-facing and MLR/PRC meetings, capturing action items, proactively identifying risks and dependencies, and ensuring follow-through.
  • Serve as a central liaison between PharmaForceIQ and vendors/partners, overseeing asset tagging, asset trafficking, and delivery, and resolving issues to keep projects on schedule and within scope.
  • Lead project management for complex, multi-channel initiatives, including HCP, patient, medical affairs, market access, and clinical trial recruitment campaigns, ensuring alignment to overall strategy and KPIs.
  • Own the development of monthly and quarterly performance reports, synthesizing data, generating insights, and providing strategic recommendations to optimize campaigns and inform future planning.
  • Oversee weekly review of dashboards and analytics to ensure data integrity, timely updates, and actionable insights for both internal and client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to optichannel strategic planning by partnering with paid media, search, creative, and data/analytics teams to translate brand and business objectives into integrated activation plans.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, tools, and best practices to increase efficiency, quality, and scalability of optichannel program execution.
  • Support new business and organic growth opportunities through input into scopes, timelines, and resourcing for optichannel programs.

Prerequisites

We value experience with pharmaceutical or biotech companies, marketing agencies, or creative agencies that support regulated healthcare brands.

Hard Skills

Required:

  • 0–2 years of experience in marketing or agency account/project management, with hands-on ownership of multi-channel campaign execution.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, and Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
  • Demonstrated project management experience (timelines, status tracking, risk management, stakeholder coordination).
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Creatopy or other banner/ad creation platforms.
  • Exposure to programmatic, paid search, or paid social channels in the context of optichannel campaigns.
  • Familiarity with dashboards and analytics tools used in digital/optichannel marketing.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including meeting facilitation and expectation setting with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and keep cross-functional teams accountable to timelines and deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into clear recommendations.
  • Highly goal-driven, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous environment.

Qualifications

  • 0–2 years of experience in marketing, account management, or project management, ideally within a media, communications, or optichannel agency supporting pharmaceutical or biotech clients.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; degree in life sciences, marketing, communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Prior experience working in the pharma and biotech industry or with HCP and patient-focused campaigns is strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines without sacrificing quality.

Why Join Us?

  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive total compensation range of $60,000- $75,000 annually, which includes base salary and eligibility for our performance-based bonus program. Final compensation will vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and overall business considerations.
  • Competitive base salary. Actual base pay will depend on varying circumstances, including the position, location, individual qualifications, market finances, and other operational business needs. This position is bonus-eligible as well.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits package.
  • A collaborative and growing workforce.

Job Title - Lead Specialist, Government Relations

Also known in the market as: Government Affairs Manager | State Government Relations Manager | Public Policy Manager | Senior Government Relations Manager | State Affairs Manager | Advocacy Manager | Education Policy Manager

Description

Pearson is seeking a Lead Specialist, Government Relations to support and advance state-level government relations, public affairs and policy engagement activities across a defined portfolio of U.S. states.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in government relations, public affairs, advocacy, policy, education, workforce development or legislative affairs who enjoys working at the intersection of policy, politics and business strategy.

You'll help Pearson build relationships with policymakers, monitor legislative and regulatory activity, develop policy materials and support advocacy initiatives that influence the future of education, workforce development and assessment programmes across the United States.

Working closely with Government Relations leadership, internal business stakeholders and external partners, you'll help ensure Pearson remains informed, engaged and well positioned as policy landscapes continue to evolve.

What You'll Be Doing

State Government Relations & Advocacy

  • Support government relations strategy and execution across an assigned portfolio of U.S. states.
  • Help coordinate advocacy initiatives, stakeholder outreach and engagement activities.
  • Support implementation of state-level engagement plans and government relations priorities.
  • Monitor emerging political, legislative and regulatory developments and elevate key risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare briefing materials and recommendations for Government Relations leadership.
  • Support the Senior Lead, U.S. Government Relations in providing advocacy support to Pearson's Assessments & Qualifications business.

Policy Monitoring, Research & Analysis

  • Track legislation, regulations and education policy developments affecting Pearson's business and customers.
  • Analyse policy developments and communicate business impacts to internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain legislative trackers, policy monitoring tools and reporting processes.
  • Prepare concise policy summaries, issue briefs and executive-level updates.
  • Research emerging policy trends and identify potential strategic implications.

Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Support engagement with policymakers, state education agencies, legislative staff, trade associations and coalition partners.
  • Coordinate meetings, briefings, outreach efforts and follow-up activities.
  • Help communicate Pearson's policy positions and priorities to external stakeholders.
  • Represent Pearson in meetings, working groups, policy discussions and industry forums where appropriate.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product, Legal, Compliance, Communications, Sales and business teams to ensure policy activity aligns with organisational priorities.
  • Gather input from internal subject matter experts to support policy positions and advocacy materials.
  • Coordinate activity with external consultants, advisors and lobbying partners.
  • Support development of aligned policy messaging and stakeholder communications.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain organised policy trackers, engagement records and reporting tools.
  • Create and improve templates, workflows and internal documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that increase team efficiency and visibility.
  • Ensure policy materials and communications are accurate, timely and aligned with Pearson objectives.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Experience in Government Relations, Public Affairs, Policy, Advocacy, Legislative Affairs or related fields.
  • Good understanding of state legislative, regulatory and public policy processes.
  • Strong research, analytical and policy-monitoring skills.
  • Excellent writing, editing and communication capabilities.
  • Ability to translate complex policy developments into clear business implications.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience balancing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work in fast-paced environments.
  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.

Preferred

  • Experience within Education, Workforce Development, Assessment or Public Sector environments.
  • Experience supporting state-level government relations programmes.
  • Experience working with policymakers, government agencies, associations or coalitions.
  • Exposure to public policy issues affecting education, workforce development, assessment or credentialing.
  • Experience managing relationships with external consultants or lobbying firms.

Key Skills

Government Relations | Public Affairs | Public Policy | State Government Affairs | Advocacy | Legislative Affairs | Stakeholder Engagement | Education Policy | Workforce Policy | Policy Analysis | Political Monitoring | Regulatory Affairs | Strategic Communications | Coalition Building | Relationship Management | Public Sector Engagement | Research & Analysis | Writing & Briefing Materials | Cross-Functional Partnership

Why Join Pearson?

  • Join one of the world's leading education and learning companies.
  • Help shape education and workforce policy across the United States.
  • Work alongside experienced government relations and policy professionals.
  • Influence initiatives that impact millions of learners.
  • Collaborate with senior leaders, policymakers and industry stakeholders.
  • Enjoy strong career development opportunities within a global organisation.
  • Flexible and collaborative working environment focused on growth and continuous learning.

Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. Summary

El Técnico en Motores Pequeños es responsable del mantenimiento y la reparación de motores pequeños utilizados en equipos de potencia para exteriores, como cortacéspedes, motosierras y sopladores de nieve. Este puesto incluye diagnosticar problemas mecánicos, realizar servicios de rutina y brindar soporte a los clientes tanto en persona como a través de consultas remotas o virtuales. El técnico asesora a los clientes sobre las reparaciones o el mantenimiento necesarios, garantiza que el equipo funcione de acuerdo con las especificaciones del fabricante y mantiene una documentación detallada del servicio para respaldar las interacciones tanto en el taller como virtuales. Los candidatos deben tener un teléfono inteligente moderno con una conexión activa a Internet para gestionar eficientemente pedidos y asignaciones a través de la aplicación de la empresa. La competencia en el manejo de aplicaciones móviles, plataformas digitales y flujos de trabajo basados en aplicaciones es esencial para ejecutar tareas y comunicarse sin problemas.

La compensación varía entre $37,440 y $62,400 por año, según la experiencia y la disponibilidad.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnosticar problemas mecánicos en equipos con motores pequeños (por ejemplo, cortacéspedes, motosierras, sopladores de nieve).
  • Realizar mantenimiento rutinario, como cambios de aceite, reemplazo de filtros de aire, inspección de bujías y limpieza de carburadores.
  • Reparar o reemplazar componentes defectuosos, como correas, bujías y sistemas de combustible.
  • Brindar a los clientes explicaciones claras sobre las reparaciones necesarias y las recomendaciones de mantenimiento.
  • Documentar el trabajo de servicio realizado y garantizar que se mantengan registros precisos para cada trabajo.
  • Garantizar que todo el equipo cumpla con las especificaciones del fabricante y funcione de manera óptima.
  • Mantener un entorno de trabajo limpio y organizado cumpliendo con los protocolos de seguridad.
  • Mantenerse actualizado sobre nuevas tecnologías y métodos de reparación de motores pequeños.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

  • Diploma de escuela secundaria o equivalente (GED).
  • Conocimientos básicos de mecánica de motores pequeños.
  • Más de 1 año de experiencia trabajando con motores pequeños.
  • Gran aptitud mecánica y capacidad para resolver problemas de motores.

Experience

  • Certificación en reparación de motores pequeños.
  • Más de 3 años de experiencia en mantenimiento y reparación de motores pequeños.
  • Excelentes habilidades para resolver problemas.
  • Experiencia previa en atención al cliente.

With flexible schedules and the ability to work remotely, you'll enjoy greater freedom and autonomy in your career. Plus, our commitment to inclusivity ensures that every team member is valued and supported. If you're ready to be part of a forward-thinking organization that's changing the game for mechanics, apply now and embark on a rewarding journey with us.

About Company

At our organization, we're on a mission to revolutionize the opportunities available in the mechanic industry by pioneering remote mechanic jobs. We believe that skilled mechanics shouldn't be limited by traditional brick-and-mortar settings but should have the flexibility to work remotely, leveraging technology to provide expert services wherever they're needed. By embracing remote work, we're empowering mechanics to optimize their schedules, reduce commuting time, and expand their reach to serve clients beyond geographical boundaries. Through innovative platforms and robust support systems, we're creating a new paradigm in the mechanic industry, one that prioritizes efficiency, accessibility, and inclusivity. Cherokee Federal is seeking an AWS Engineer to design, deploy, and support secure, scalable AWS cloud solutions for a federal client. This role focuses on AWS infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), CI/CD automation, cloud security, and DevOps in a regulated government environment. Ideal candidates have 5+ years of AWS experience, strong cloud engineering skills, and experience supporting federal or public sector cloud environments. Salesforce experience, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, or MuleSoft, is a plus.

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

Responsibilities Include:
• Design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS in support of government mission requirements.
• Work with government leads and Product Owners to understand technical requirements, clarify scope, and confirm release timing for new infrastructure and enhancement requests.
• Architect and implement AWS solutions using services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, ECS/EKS, and API Gateway.

• Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and related tooling to ensure system health, performance, and operational visibility.
• Ensure cloud infrastructure is secure, scalable, and maintainable, and aligned with government governance, auditability, security, and compliance expectations (e.g., FedRAMP, agency ATO requirements, NIST 800-53).
• Configure and manage networking, security groups, encryption, and identity/access controls in accordance with federal security standards.
• Support integrations between AWS-hosted systems and external platforms (e.g., APIs, middleware, third-party SaaS), confirming data integrity across systems.
• Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, performance, and deployment issues; document root cause and remediation.
• Present formal and informal oral and written briefings to government managers; produce executive-ready technical summaries and decision support materials.
• Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities Requested:
• Bachelor's degree with preferred study in Computer Science, Information Science, Information Systems Management, Math, Statistics, Operations Research, or Engineering and a minimum of five (5) years of experience. Seven (7) years of work experience in related field may be substituted for education.
• Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and maintaining AWS cloud infrastructure in support of federal or public sector clients.
• Hands-on experience with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, ECS/EKS).
• Experience with infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK).
• Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation.
• Strong understanding of cloud security, networking, and identity/access management in a regulated environment.
• Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions on AWS.
• Experience working within FedRAMP, ATO, or NIST 800-53 compliance frameworks preferred.
• AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or DevOps Engineer) preferred.
• Salesforce experience, including with any of its products (e.g., Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, MuleSoft), is a bonus.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to brief senior government stakeholders.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a government-required background investigation or security clearance as needed.

• U.S. Citizenship is required.

  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Company Information:

***As required by our governmental client, this position requires U.S. Citizenship***

Cherokee Federal is seeking an AWS Engineer to design, deploy, and support secure, scalable AWS cloud solutions for a federal client. This role focuses on AWS infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), CI/CD automation, cloud security, and DevOps in a regulated government environment. Ideal candidates have 5+ years of AWS experience, strong cloud engineering skills, and experience supporting federal or public sector cloud environments. Salesforce experience, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, or MuleSoft, is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits:
Estimated Starting Salary Range for AWS Engineer: $100,000-140,000

Pay commensurate with experience.

Full time benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, and other possible benefits as provided. Benefits are subject to change with or without notice.

Responsibilities Include:
• Design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS in support of government mission requirements.
• Work with government leads and Product Owners to understand technical requirements, clarify scope, and confirm release timing for new infrastructure and enhancement requests.
• Architect and implement AWS solutions using services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, ECS/EKS, and API Gateway.
• Build and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK to ensure repeatable, auditable, and version-controlled deployments.
• Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, GitLab CI) to automate build, test, and deployment workflows.
• Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and related tooling to ensure system health, performance, and operational visibility.
• Ensure cloud infrastructure is secure, scalable, and maintainable, and aligned with government governance, auditability, security, and compliance expectations (e.g., FedRAMP, agency ATO requirements, NIST 800-53).
• Configure and manage networking, security groups, encryption, and identity/access controls in accordance with federal security standards.
• Support integrations between AWS-hosted systems and external platforms (e.g., APIs, middleware, third-party SaaS), confirming data integrity across systems.
• Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, performance, and deployment issues; document root cause and remediation.
• Present formal and informal oral and written briefings to government managers; produce executive-ready technical summaries and decision support materials.
• Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Experience, Education, Skills, Abilities Requested:
• Bachelor's degree with preferred study in Computer Science, Information Science, Information Systems Management, Math, Statistics, Operations Research, or Engineering and a minimum of five (5) years of experience. Seven (7) years of work experience in related field may be substituted for education.
• Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and maintaining AWS cloud infrastructure in support of federal or public sector clients.
• Hands-on experience with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation, ECS/EKS).
• Experience with infrastructure as code (CloudFormation, Terraform, or AWS CDK).
• Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation.
• Strong understanding of cloud security, networking, and identity/access management in a regulated environment.
• Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions on AWS.
• Experience working within FedRAMP, ATO, or NIST 800-53 compliance frameworks preferred.
• AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or DevOps Engineer) preferred.
• Salesforce experience, including with any of its products (e.g., Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, MuleSoft), is a bonus.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to brief senior government stakeholders.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a government-required background investigation or security clearance as needed.

Technical Customer Success Manager, NA West

Remote - US or Canada, Pacific or Mountain time zone | Quarterly Travel

About Akuity

With the move to the cloud, Kubernetes has become widely adopted by DevOps and Platform Engineering teams, but it has also added complexity. While scaling Kubernetes at Intuit, the Akuity founders started building Argo CD in order to streamline the adoption of Kubernetes. Argo CD helps developers own, understand and deploy their K8s deployments via GitOps.

Today, Argo CD is the third most popular project in the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) and is used by 70% of companies who are using Kubernetes in production. The list of Argo CD users includes companies like Intuit, BlackRock, Tesla, Major League Baseball, Peloton, and many more.

The team founded Akuity in 2021 to enable enterprises to ship software faster and more reliably with modern GitOps best practices. The Akuity Platform enables teams to manage the development and deployment across hundreds – if not thousands – of Kubernetes clusters from a single control plane. Trusted by top companies around the globe, the Akuity Platform provides the only end-to-end GitOps platform for the enterprises.

Our mission is to simplify the software delivery process so that DevOps and Platform Engineering teams can move fast, and deploy code effortlessly without the fear of breaking things.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Customer Success Manager at Akuity you’ll work closely with customers to guide them through their Argo journey, drive adoption, and ensure they realize maximum value from Akuity’s platform. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor, helping customers achieve their business and technical goals while advocating for their needs internally.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage a portfolio of strategic accounts with full responsibility across the customer lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption to renewal.
  • Build relationships with customers and serve as the trusted advisor to drive continued value from Akuity’s products and services.
  • Lead strategic meetings and Executive Business Reviews to share best practices and tactical recommendations.
  • Drive implementation and onboarding with a focus on accelerating time to value.
  • Develop, prepare, and nurture customers for advocacy and long-term partnership.
  • Work with customers to define and achieve business and technical goals, KPIs, and success metrics.
  • Partner with sales to drive renewals, expansions, and up-sell opportunities.
  • Advocate customer needs across product, engineering, marketing, and support teams.
  • Manage accounts across different stages of the customer lifecycle.

What We Look For

Must Have

  • 2+ years of experience supporting customers in a Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or similar role.
  • Prior experience working with clients of all sizes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both engineers and executives.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Naturally curious, eager to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Nice to Have

  • 5+ years overall experience in customer-facing roles.
  • Technical background, ideally with hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, GitOps, or Cloud Native technologies.
  • Experience driving adoption, retention, and customer advocacy.
  • Up-to-date on the latest trends in the DevOps ecosystem.

Why Akuity?

At Akuity, we believe open-source software is the most impactful way to build lasting technology. We founded this company to advocate for Argo, share our expertise, and be a trusted partner to its users.

Our culture is grounded in humility, authenticity, and diversity. We value people from different backgrounds and paths in life. We trust our team members to take ownership, act responsibly, and support one another. If you are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to helping customers succeed, we’d love to meet you.

Akuity is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

raw.description:
Role Overview

InoHealth is building the customer side of a preventive health platform — and this role owns it entirely. You will build and own the customer excellence function from scratch: support infrastructure, onboarding programs, training systems, and the operational frameworks that deliver exceptional outcomes at scale.
This is a builder-operator role: you design the architecture and run it yourself. The builder and the operator are the same person, and that dual-mode will persist well beyond the build phase — this is a role for someone who finds energy in both. InoHealth serves HCPs, corporate clients, and health insurance companies — with hospitals on the near-term horizon. You will design tiered engagement models that scale across all segments without proportional headcount growth, own retention and account health across the portfolio, and build the outsourced support layer as volumes increase. This role has a clear path toward team leadership as the company grows.

Responsibilities

Support infrastructure and operations

  • Personally architect, configure, and launch the full support stack — you own the tools end-to-end: Jira routing, Intercom, CRM, knowledge base, SLA definitions, escalation logic, and AI-assisted triage. Configure Jira workflows to route bugs, product feedback, and data queries to Product, Engineering, and Data Science — with full traceability and closure loops. Integrate Instabug or equivalent in-app feedback into the support pipeline for automated capture and routing.
  • Build AI-augmented workflows to absorb insurance-driven ticket volume without linear headcount growth. Own the full KPI cycle hands-on: set definitions, build dashboards, pull numbers, and investigate anomalies yourself — you are the first person reviewing the queue when CSAT drops or resolution times spike.
  • Translate that ground-level analysis into structured, insight-driven leadership reporting. Track account health, proactively identify at-risk segments, and own retention and expansion initiatives. Lead strategic reviews and escalation management for key insurance and clinic accounts.

Outsourced support, onboarding and engagement

  • In the early stage, you are the multilingual support function — handling queries across languages, setting tone standards, building playbooks from live interactions. As volume grows, transition into BPO supervision: vendor selection, calibration sessions, agent review, quality scorecards, and compliance enforcement. You build the standards before you hold others to them.
  • Design and own onboarding programs for all segments — HCPs, corporate clients, insurance partners, and end users — each calibrated to context and regulatory environment. Develop training materials, guides, and self-serve libraries using AI tools for generation, localisation, and maintenance. Design a tiered engagement model — from high-touch institutional stewardship to automated self-serve flows — with clear transition rules across tiers as accounts evolve.
  • Represent customer insight in product, commercial, and regulatory discussions. Partner with BD on institutional onboarding and pilots. Collaborate with Regulatory & Compliance on QMS documentation and GDPR obligations across all support operations.

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated experience functioning as both strategic owner and individual contributor of a customer excellence or operations function — typically acquired over 5+ years but assessed on depth of ownership rather than tenure alone.
  • Proven ability to operate as the first and only person in a function: built processes from a blank slate, with full accountability for outcomes before the systems that produce them existed.
  • HCP-facing experience in diagnostics, digital health, or medical devices — familiar with clinical workflows and healthcare professional expectations.
  • Consumer health or B2C digital health experience — understanding of end-user support dynamics and consumer-grade service expectations.
  • Proficiency with Jira for ticket routing and escalation; experience with Intercom, Zendesk, HubSpot Service Hub, or equivalent support platforms.
  • Familiarity with Instabug or equivalent in-app feedback tools integrated into support pipelines.
  • Active, practical use of AI tools to automate support workflows — demonstrated with concrete examples.
  • Excellent English; German is strongly preferred given our launch markets in Germany and Switzerland. Additional European languages (French, Italian, Spanish) are a meaningful advantage.

Nice to have

  • Experience managing BPO operations — vendor selection, quality frameworks, multilingual agent supervision.
  • Exposure to IVD, SaMD, or regulated health environments; awareness of ISO 13485, IVDR, or GDPR is a plus

What We Offer

  • A preventive health platform built on proprietary algorithms and validated health insights — at the frontier of a fundamental shift from reactive treatment to predictive, personalized prevention.
  • High-ownership role with direct impact on product direction and company growth, and a clear path toward team leadership as the company scales.
  • Full remote flexibility across Europe, with occasional travel for partner meetings and company offsites. Compensation aligned with seniority, benchmarked to your location within Europe.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreOnYourMark Education is a high dosage virtual tutoring service providing individualized virtual literacy instruction grounded in the science of reading.
raw.description:
Who We Are

OnYourMark Education is a high dosage virtual tutoring service providing individualized virtual literacy instruction grounded in the science of reading. We partner with schools as a supplement to the literacy instruction already in place to ensure students get the foundational reading skills they need to excel!

Why We Exist

OnYourMark exists to ensure that the students we serve have a strong foundation to become thriving readers. We also believe that spreading an understanding of the science of how children learn to read can be transformative for tutors, teachers, children, and families. Getting foundational literacy skills right early will support children to read on grade level and diminish the need for schools to remediate at their current levels.

Why Apply

When you become an OnYourMark Literacy Tutor, you commit to supporting students in becoming lifelong readers with the foundational reading skills to tackle future school and life challenges. Becoming an OnYourMark Literacy Tutor is right for you if you are invested in having an impact on the lives of young people, are committed to learning new skills, and are inspired by being a part of eradicating educational inequities.

Who Should Apply

Becoming an OnYourMark Literacy Tutor is perfect for college students, college-aged students taking gap years, recent high school and college graduates, current tutors, and retired and part-time educators. It is ideal for those who love working with children and are interested in learning more about a career in education. Successfully building tutoring skills will open up possibilities to continue as a tutor, tutor coach, and build a resume that opens doors for future opportunities in schools as teachers, leaders, and beyond.

Position Overview

OnYourMark Literacy Tutors provide virtual high-dosage tutoring to Kindergarten through 8th-grade students grounded in the science of reading. Tutors learn how to teach an explicit phonics curriculum to support the development of foundational reading skills. Literacy Tutors will support students through one-on-one or small groups in a virtual setting. This individualized approach will increase the speed at which students develop as readers by third grade, the year that research shows students must master these skills to engage in increasingly complex texts as they progress in school and life.

Upon successful completion of onboarding and training requirements, tutors will enter the Tutoring Pool. During this time, tutors will sign up for available one-off tutoring sessions in need of substitute coverage until they are offered a schedule. Schedule assignments are based on school schedule needs and tutor availability. OnYourMark shall use its best efforts to provide a placement for tutors to provide tutoring services, but shall not guarantee a specific placement.

Your Commitments

  • Participate in paid virtual pre-service training: approximately 22 hours for new tutors or 4 hours for most returning tutors.
  • Attend and complete ongoing professional development learning sessions and scheduled coaching, individualized or small group sessions, as assigned during active tutoring contract.
  • Manage a caseload of students by building strong relationships, collecting data regarding progress, preparing lesson materials, and supporting students in their prescribed learning sequence.
  • Track student reading skill progress over the course of tutoring sessions via scheduled progress monitoring assessment and student survey completions.
  • Commit to a tutoring schedule aligned with the academic calendar year. Programming typically runs from September through June, though hours and schedules can vary considerably within that window. There is typically a 3-4 week break in tutoring around the holidays December and January, aligned with typical school breaks. Exact dates may vary by school. Limited summer hours may be available in July.
  • To effectively support our program, tutors must be available during the hours when OnYourMark offers tutoring services.
  • Learn from literacy experts and deepen your understanding of how children learn to read, grounded in the science of reading.
  • Inspire a love of reading and learning in the students you serve.

Additional requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Hold a high school diploma or equivalent, GED
  • Reside within the contiguous U.S., Hawaii, or Alaska and be authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Tutors must satisfy an online comprehensive background check and, if applicable, complete the appropriate fingerprinting requirements outlined by each school partner assignment.
  • Have a computer with a Chrome browser and a working microphone &video. Your internet connection must support a minimum of 25 megabytes per second for download and 25 megabytes per second for upload.

Compensation

Literacy Tutors are compensated at a rate of $17.50/hour for non-student-facing activities including training, tutor development, administrative tasks, and in scope tutoring lesson preparation. Early Literacy Tutors are also compensated at a rate of $18.25/hour for facilitating tutoring sessions and other student-facing activities.

Tutors also have the opportunity to substitute for additional one-off sessions as available for additional compensation.

Salary: $17.50

Key Responsibilities

Email Marketing Specialist

Philippines Temporary - Remote

Company and Vision
PlanetArt’s vision is to be the leading seller of personalized and make-on-demand products worldwide. We provide consumers with unmatched tools and content and an unparalleled end-to-end customer experience that result in high-quality, meaningful finished products and memorable celebrations of life events.

The company’s brands include the popular FreePrints and FreePrints Photobooks apps and the industry leading SimplytoImpress card and stationery site, as well as Personal Creations, CafePress and ISeeMe! Visit www.planetart.com to learn more about our brands.

We have more than 500 team members across multiple offices, primarily in Calabasas CA, San Diego CA, Woodridge IL, Minneapolis, MN and Pleasanton, CA. We also have team members in two company-owned offices in China, as well as in Europe.


Job Overview
PlanetArt is looking for an Email Marketing Specialist. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, strategizing, building, executing, and analyzing email and SMS marketing campaigns for CafePress. You will work closely with designers, merchandising teams, and CafePress’ Sr. Email Marketing Manager to bring campaigns to life—while also communicating performance insights and strategic recommendations to leadership. If you're a data-driven problem solver with a creative eye and a knack for attention to detail, this is a great fit.

This is a temporary fully remote, work-from-home position. Possibility to convert to Full-Time, Long Term.

What You'll Do
Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, build, and deploy email and SMS campaigns in Cordial and Attentive
  • Maintain and execute a promotional email calendar that strategically aligns CafePress products with offers, seasonality, and audience segments
  • Execute the build for promotional offers and promo codes, ensuring correct setup and seamless customer redemption
  • Review creative mock-ups and copywriting drafted by the Design team, providing approval or actionable feedback to ensure accuracy and brand alignment
  • Build and maintain audience segments and suppression lists within Cordial for targeted messaging
  • Track performance metrics, run A/B tests, and interpret results to inform future campaign strategy
  • Compile and deliver weekly campaign performance reports with clear insights and recommendations for leadership
  • Manage email proofing, QA, render checks, scheduling, and final send parameters
  • Coordinate with design and merchandising teams to ensure campaigns align with product positioning and brand priorities
  • Perform other duties and special projects assigned as needed
What You Should Have
Skills, Qualifications, and Requirements
Required Experience:
  • 3–5 years of hands-on email marketing experience, including campaign execution within an ESP (Cordial experience a plus)
  • Strong understanding of email KPIs (open rate, CTR, CTOR, bounce rate, unsubscribe rate) and e-commerce metrics (revenue, AOV, conversion rate, etc) and what stories they tell to inform campaign optimization
Required Skills:
  • Marketing Strategy & Planning: Ability to manage and execute a promotional calendar aligned with seasonal trends, product priorities, and business goals
  • Campaign Analysis: Ability to interpret A/B test results and translate data into clear strategic recommendations
  • Email Platforms & Automation: Familiarity with ESPs (Cordial preferred) and SMS platforms (Attentive preferred) for campaign management, automation, and analytics
  • Audience Management: Experience with segmentation and suppression logic within an ESP to optimize campaign targeting based on the customer lifecycle
  • HTML & CSS: Working knowledge for light edits within existing templates; full coding ability is a bonus
  • Excel / Reporting: Proficient in building tables, charts, and graphs for campaign reporting
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills; comfortable presenting to leadership and cross-functional partners
Bonus Points:
  • Cordial or Attentive platform experience
  • Marketing platform certifications
  • Full HTML/CSS email development capability
  • Experience using AI tools for email coding or content generation
Who You Are
  • A strategic thinker who understands how to align promotions, products, and timing for maximum impact
  • Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple campaigns in a fast-paced e-commerce environment
  • Analytically minded—you interpret data, spot trends, and turn metrics into actionable recommendations
  • A strong collaborator who works effectively with design, merchandising, and cross-functional teams
  • A proactive communicator who flags issues early and keeps stakeholders informed
  • Comfortable working remotely across time zones and quick to learn new tools as the stack evolves
What You Can Expect
Working Conditions
  • Position requires long term and fully remote work scheduled from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Pacific Time
  • Position requires regular, continuous use of computer.
  • Position requires regular sitting and standing.
  • Position requires regular interaction with team members through the following methods: phone, WebEx, Slack, or email.

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.

What if your project leadership skills helped new medicines take their first step in human clinical trials?

Fortrea is one of the world´s largest and longest-established early-phase clinical research organizations.

From first-in-human to exploratory biomarker or complex ph1b programs, our Clinical Pharmacology teams generate critical safety, tolerability, PK and PD data that help new medicines to move forward.

We are currently hiring a Project Manager II in the UK to drive this mission forward.

This is a full-time, remote job.

DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned Healthy Volunteers and Patient Clinical Pharmacology projects independently or under the direction of a Senior Project Lead, overseeing complex, high‑value studies across regional / global, cross‑functional teams.

AND YOUR LONG-TERM CONTRIBUTION?

You will play a key role in strengthening how Fortrea delivers Phase Ib clinical trials, helping evolve our approach to more complex early‑phase programs.

Beyond individual projects, your experience will support process innovation and operational delivery, influencing how Phase Ib studies are planned, executed, and scaled across Clinical Pharmacology Services.

We are seeking an accomplished and goal-driven Area Sales Manager, with deep expertise in renewables, particularly within solar, wind, energy storage, and the TIC industry. This is a high-impact role, ideal for a strategic sales leader with a proven track record in driving revenue growth, market development, and customer engagement across the United Kingdom. You will join STS, a key player in the global renewable energy sector with operations spanning the Globe. We are looking for individuals, much like yourself, who are passionate about renewable energies, technology, quality, and sustainability.

Position Overview

Ensure the development and realization of sales targets by implementing effective strategies and plans tailored for the United Kingdom market, aiming at maximizing sales and sustained profitability. Undertake business development and sales activities that enable company clients to select the most relevant technical solutions, delivering high market presence and sustained profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a business development strategic plan in the United Kingdom, obtain approval and execute it.
  • Execute the company's objectives and sales targets maximizing sales revenues.
  • Identify target markets, customer segments, and sales channels to focus efforts and resources effectively.
  • Manage the sales pipelines within the CRM system, tracking leads, sales opportunities, and deals through each stage of the sales process.
  • Maintain accurate and current CRM data, with a particular emphasis on order closing and job start dates, enabling coordination and operational resource planning, to ensure high utilization rates.
  • Manage relationships with existing customers to build loyalty, create opportunities for repeat business, as well as upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Present STS services to clients and provide expert advice on selecting relevant services.
  • Forecast future sales revenues and trends based on historical data, market analysis, sales pipeline projections, and potential growth opportunities.
  • Travel will be required for within the United Kingdom (manager to confirm frequency).

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Sales, Marketing or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of successful experience, preferably in technical or industrial services within the United Kingdom.
  • Proven track record of developing sales strategies, managing key accounts, and achieving sales targets across multiple countries.
  • Experience working with CRM tools and managing full sales pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with operational teams and deliver integrated solutions to clients.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); knowledge of other languages such as Spanish is an advantage.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities.
  • Deep understanding of sales analytics, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity when working across diverse regions.

Terms and Conditions

  • Location: Remote, England.
  • Contract type: Permanent
  • Type: Full Time
  • Competitive annual salary
  • Commission scheme.
  • Department: Sales
  • Position Reports to: Senior Technical Account Manager.

STS – At the Forefront of the Global Renewable Energy Industry

At STS, we serve as technical advisors, auditors, and inspectors, empowering our clients - including major renewable energy project developers, owners, operators, and IPPs - to make sustainable decisions for every aspect of their projects. As pioneers and global leaders in renewables, we have expanded our expertise far beyond inspection and auditing to deliver exceptional value to our clients across a broad range of services.

Global, Diverse and Inclusive

As a global employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported. We believe that diversity fuels innovation and strengthens our workplace culture, creating a dynamic space for growth and collaboration. Inclusivity is one of our core values, making us a top choice for those seeking an employer that truly embraces diversity and cultivates talent.

Join Us

Your journey to make a real impact starts here. Join our extraordinary global team and become a catalyst for growth in the renewable energy sector. Send us your CV. We cannot wait to meet you and discover how you can shape the future with us.
